title: SDK Initialization, Lifecycle, and Process Isolation Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies sdk initialization, lifecycle, and process isolation?
options: Make initialization explicit or narrowly justified, idempotent, process-aware, consent-aware, measurable, and safely degradable.
questions.answer: Make initialization explicit or narrowly justified, idempotent, process-aware, consent-aware, measurable, and safely degradable.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A ContentProvider initializer runs only after Application.onCreate has completed.
questions.explanation: An auto-initializing provider that contacts the network can delay every app process and collect data before the host establishes consent.

questions.prompt: Why separate SDK configuration from activation?
questions.answer: The host can validate setup and establish consent or lifecycle before starting work, collection, threads, or network access.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
